title: Senior Product Specialist Partner Solutions Architect
description: <p>A newly created role to help Databricks create new product categories. As Databricks accelerates its most strategic products, we are investing ahead of the curve in the partner ecosystem that helps our customers adopt them, and we are building a new specialisation function to lead that effort. You will pioneer it across EMEA.</p> <p>Reporting to: Director, Partner Field Engineering (EMEA).</p> <p>As the Senior Product Specialist Partner Solutions Architect, you own how our leading System Integrator partners develop deep, market-leading expertise in Databricks' priority products:</p> <ul> <li><strong>OLTP/Postgres (Lakebase):</strong> Databricks' fully managed, Postgres-compatible operational (OLTP) database for intelligent applications</li> <li><strong>Product AI (Genie):</strong> Databricks' natural-language analytics experience, letting anyone ask questions of governed data conversationally</li> <li><strong>AI Router &amp; Governance (Unity Gateway):</strong> Databricks' governed gateway for securely managing, monitoring and routing access to AI and large language model endpoints</li> <li><strong>Migrations &amp; Modernisation:</strong> moving legacy data warehouses and platforms onto the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform</li> <li><strong>Turn-key Solutions:</strong> Cybersecurity (Lakewatch) and CDP (CustomerLake) with more to come</li> </ul> <p>Your mandate is to take our leading partners to the highest tier of Centre-of-Excellence product specialisation on these products, and to turn them into independent, market-leading extensions of the Databricks field. Working hand in hand with our EMEA Product Specialist team, you will carry both the deep technical narrative and the business-value and go-to-market narrative that get these products positioned, adopted and scaled through the partner channel. This is a builder's role: you will design the blueprint for a partner product-specialist function that Databricks scales globally, starting in EMEA.</p> <h2><strong>What we are trying to achieve</strong></h2> <p>Databricks' priority products are seeing strong momentum across EMEA. Lakebase is one of the fastest-growing additions to our platform, Unity Gateway is newly generally available, and AI/BI + Genie are changing how customers work with their data. As adoption accelerates, our partners are central to helping customers realise value quickly and at scale. Deepening partner expertise in these products is one of the most powerful levers we have to accelerate customer time-to-value, and this role exists to build that capability deliberately and ahead of demand, so our partners lead the market.</p> <h2><strong>What the role owns</strong></h2> <ul> <li><strong>Building the partner specialist community (the day-to-day).</strong> Select, enable and certify leading EMEA partners to the highest tier of product specialisation, running the enablement engine end to end: partner selection, technical upskilling to expert depth, certification and first joint customer wins.</li> <li><strong>Partnering with our Product Specialist team.</strong> Act as the partner-side counterpart to Databricks' EMEA Product Specialists, bringing the latest product expertise to partners, connecting partner enablement to live customer opportunities, and channelling partner and customer adoption insight back to our product organisation.</li> <li><strong>Scaling specialist capacity through partners.</strong> Grow models where specialised partners bring product-specialist capacity to joint customers, so expertise scales across the ecosystem.</li> <li><strong>Launch-partner motions.</strong> Position specialised partners as launch partners for major product releases, signalling ecosystem trust and accelerating go-to-market at each milestone.</li> <li><strong>Thought leadership and the business-value narrative.</strong> Author the "better-together" technical and commercial story for these products in the partner channel: reference architectures, positioning, partner offers and value framing that let partners sell and deliver independently. Be a visible voice for partner product specialisation, internally and externally.</li> <li><strong>Building the function.</strong> Define the operating model, the specialisation and certification criteria, the partner selection bar and the cadence, and create the template Databricks adopts to scale this function worldwide.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>The impact you will have</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Accelerate customer adoption and time-to-value on Databricks' priority products by putting genuine product depth into the partner channel.</li> <li>Grow partner-led momentum behind our fastest-growing products, building partner capability ahead of the demand curve.</li> <li>Elevate leading EMEA System Integrators to full independence on the priority products, so they operate as market leaders and true extensions of the Databricks field.</li> <li>Establish a repeatable, globally scalable partner product-specialist function, proven in EMEA and exported across Databricks.</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What we look for</strong></h2> <ul> <li>Extensive hands-on experience with the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform, with genuine depth in at least two of the priority products above and the ability to get to depth quickly on the rest. This is a senior role for an established Databricks expert.</li> <li>Proven ability to build partner or field capability at scale: enablement, certification and community-building that turns others into independent experts.</li> <li>Strong business-value and go-to-market instinct: able to translate technical depth into commercial positioning and partner-led market impact, and to engage partner and customer organisations at senior-executive level.</li> <li>Demonstrated thought leadership: authoring technical and business content (reference architectures, solution guides, positioning, playbooks) and presenting complex products credibly to technical and executive audiences.</li> <li>At least 5 years of technical pre-sales or sales-methodology experience in a consumption business model, and experience designing and delivering end-to-end data, warehousing and AI architectures.</li> <li>Coding experience in a core language (Python, SQL, Java or Scala) and hands-on experience building data applications or AI agents.</li> <li>The maturity to build a new function from the ground up: defining the operating model, standards and cadence, and managing multiple changing priorities across a partner ecosystem and internal teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Nice to have:</strong> System Integrator or consulting background; experience with transactional databases (e.g. PostgreSQL) and application development; experience with LLM gateways, AI governance or AI security; experience running partner specialisation, certification or champion programmes; additional European languages.</p> <p>The role requires up to 40% travel across EMEA, to partner sites, Databricks offices and key industry events.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>About Databricks</strong></p> <p><span style="font-family: arial, sans-serif;">Databricks is the Data and AI company. More than 20,000 organizations worldwide — including adidas, AT&amp;T, Bayer, Block, Mastercard, Rivian, Unilever, and 70% of the Fortune 500 — rely on the Databricks Data + AI Platform to build and scale data and AI apps, analytics and agents. Headquartered in San Francisco with 30+ offices around the globe, Databricks offers a unified platform that includes Genie, Lakebase, Agent Bricks, Lakeflow, Lakehouse, and Unity Catalog. To learn more, follow Databricks on <a href="https://www.linkedin.com/company/databricks">LinkedIn</a>, <a href="https://x.com/databricks">X</a>, <a href="https://www.youtube.com/@Databricks">YouTube</a>, and <a href="https://www.instagram.com/databricksinc/?hl=en">Instagram</a>.<br><br><strong>Benefits<br><br></strong></span>At Databricks, we strive to provide comprehensive benefits and perks that meet the needs of all of our employees. For specific details on the benefits offered in your region click <a href="https://docs.google.com/document/d/154un3e8Xav4BceOSlcYFZRGEuQI54xMxVydRwQn54eQ/edit?usp=sharing">here</a>.<br><br></p> <p><strong>Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion</strong></p> <p>At Databricks, we are committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive culture where everyone can excel. We take great care to ensure that our hiring practices are inclusive and meet equal employment opportunity standards. Individuals looking for employment at Databricks are considered without regard to age, color, disability, ethnicity, family or marital status, gender identity or expression, language, national origin, physical and mental ability, political affiliation, race, religion, sexual orientation, socio-economic status, veteran status, and other protected characteristics.</p> <p><strong>Compliance</strong></p> <p><strong><span style="font-weight: 400;">If access to export-controlled technology or source code is required for performance of job duties, it is within Employer's discretion whether to apply for a U.S. government license for such positions, and Employer may decline to proceed with an applicant on this basis alone.</span></strong></p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
description: About Niantic Spatial AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time. That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are. In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right. Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us. About the Role You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems. The World Map team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and handheld devices, aerial imagery, LiDAR, and 360 cameras, as well as external geographic and elevation data. The central challenge is to harmonize these data sources, quantify uncertainty, and maintain consistency as the map evolves. You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and scalable engineering — developing new approaches to geospatial registration, correspondence, and geometric optimization, then productionizing these technologies to directly improve Niantic Spatial's world model. What You'll Do Geospatial Registration — Develop and advance algorithms for world-scale georeferencing and registration across imagery, 3D reconstructions, point clouds, and geographic reference data. 3D Geometry & Correspondence — Build and improve methods spanning multi-view geometry, SfM, SLAM, feature matching, learned correspondence, bundle adjustment, point-cloud registration, and ICP. Data & Evaluation — Create the data and evaluation flywheel for world-scale mapping — design and maintain large-scale datasets, pipelines, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies that expose hard failure modes, accelerate research iteration, and support production. Learning-Based 3D Reasoning — Explore and develop learning-based approaches for geospatial understanding, combining transformers and 3D foundation models with geometric priors and uncertainty modeling. Production Robustness — Design robust solutions for challenging real-world conditions: sparse or noisy GPS, changing appearance, inconsistent reconstruction quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps. Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping — as well as engineering and product teams — to identify high-impact problems and turn research breakthroughs into end-to-end production systems. Research Communication — Share results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, and internal presentations; contribute to publications and open research where appropriate. What You'll Bring Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, Photogrammetry, or a closely related field — or equivalent research or industry experience. Strong grounding in 3D computer vision, machine learning, robotics, photogrammetry, or a closely related area. Demonstrated experience with 3D geometry and several relevant areas — multi-view reconstruction, SfM, SLAM, camera pose estimation, point-cloud registration, image-based localization, georeferencing, or sensor fusion. raw.title: 3D Computer Vision Research Engineer - World Map
raw.description:
About Niantic Spatial

AI has learned from almost everything online, but it still struggles with the physical world, where 99.5% of economic activity happens. It doesn’t know where things are, how spaces fit together, or what changes over time.

That’s one of the biggest unsolved problems in AI, and it’s the one we’re solving at Niantic Spatial. We build spatial AI models and services so people and machines can reason, learn and act safely in the physical world. We turn camera imagery, video, sensor data and archives into accurate, AI-readable representations of real places that robots can train in and machines can use to know exactly where they are.

In physical AI, mistakes have real consequences. That’s why we build AI grounded in measured reality, not guesswork, so the people and machines relying on it can trust it to get things right.

Our team built some of the world’s most widely used maps. Now we’re building something bigger: a living, measured record of the real world that machines can query, learn from and use to understand how places change over time. If you want to help AI understand the world we actually live in, come build with us.

About the Role

You'll help build the geometric foundation of the next-generation world map — joining our World Map Research Engineering team (Geospatial Alignment) as a Research Engineer or Senior Research Engineer. This is an end-to-end applied research role that spans from strong engineering and data-systems work to R&D in 3D deep learning, transformers, and foundation models. You'll develop new algorithms, produce the research data and evaluation assets needed to advance them, and engineer the resulting capabilities into dependable production systems.

The World Map team works with heterogeneous captures from phones and handheld devices, aerial imagery, LiDAR, and 360 cameras, as well as external geographic and elevation data. The central challenge is to harmonize these data sources, quantify uncertainty, and maintain consistency as the map evolves.

You'll work at the intersection of cutting-edge research and scalable engineering — developing new approaches to geospatial registration, correspondence, and geometric optimization, then productionizing these technologies to directly improve Niantic Spatial's world model.

What You'll Do

  • Geospatial Registration — Develop and advance algorithms for world-scale georeferencing and registration across imagery, 3D reconstructions, point clouds, and geographic reference data.

  • Data & Evaluation — Create the data and evaluation flywheel for world-scale mapping — design and maintain large-scale datasets, pipelines, benchmarks, and evaluation methodologies that expose hard failure modes, accelerate research iteration, and support production.

  • Learning-Based 3D Reasoning — Explore and develop learning-based approaches for geospatial understanding, combining transformers and 3D foundation models with geometric priors and uncertainty modeling.

  • Production Robustness — Design robust solutions for challenging real-world conditions: sparse or noisy GPS, changing appearance, inconsistent reconstruction quality, large geographic extents, and imperfect reference maps.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration — Partner with leading researchers in visual localization, 3D computer vision, and mapping — as well as engineering and product teams — to identify high-impact problems and turn research breakthroughs into end-to-end production systems.

  • Research Communication — Share results clearly through technical writing, design reviews, and internal presentations; contribute to publications and open research where appropriate.

LOCATION: King's Cross, London · PATTERN: Lab-based, full-time

The opportunity

We're a stealth startup in AI and bio, building infrastructure for data generation. The team is small and elite, the problems are hard, and the foundations are being laid right now. You'd help write them from the first line, with real ownership and a direct line to the founders.

This role sits at the start of our protein work. Every measurement we make depends on the protein in the well being the right one, made the same way every time, and you would be one of the people making it.

About us

AI for biology has a data problem. The data that matters most doesn't exist yet, so we're

building the infrastructure to produce it, with quality and traceability built in from day one.

We're in stealth and heads-down on execution. We'll share more about what we're building once you've spoken with the team.

The role

You will make proteins, many of them at once. The work runs from DNA through to purified, quality-checked protein in 96-well format, ready for the binding and biophysical assays downstream of you.

On the DNA side you will prepare expression templates from synthetic gene fragments, by PCR and by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and check them before they go forward. You will express proteins in cell-free systems first, with E. coli and mammalian (HEK293) expression following as the menu grows. You will purify them by affinity capture, mostly on magnetic beads in plates, and confirm what you made with quantification, CE-SDS and SEC.

Every step is recorded as you go: what went in, which lot, which conditions, what came out, and what failed. Failed expressions and poor yields are kept as data, so they get the same care as the successes.

As protocols settle you will help move them from the bench onto liquid handlers and our automated platform, working with the engineers who build it. This is a hands-on bench role, and in a small team you will also support the work either side of production when it needs doing. Downstream, that means molecular characterisation runs. Alongside, it means the cell culture behind our cell-based assays, from routine passage and banking to seeding assay plates.

Your first 90 days

FIRST 30 DAYS

◆ Run our core DNA preparation, cell-free expression and purification protocols to a

consistent standard.

◆ Learn how a sample is tracked, from DNA order to purified protein, and what gets

recorded at each step.

DAYS 30 TO 60

◆ Take a full plate of constructs from DNA through expression, purification and QC with

minimal support.

◆ Support on one step beyond production, such as a downstream characterisation

readout, a mammalian expression run or routine culture for the cell-based assay panel.

◆ Revise one protocol, including how its failures are captured.

DAYS 60 TO 90

◆ Run production week to week as part of the team, with QC results others can rely on

without checking.

◆ Own and routinely execute a downstream characterisation readout, a mammalian

expression route or maintenance of cell lines for a cell-based assay.

Who you are

You are a hands-on protein scientist who likes the bench and cares about doing the same thing well many times over. You have expressed and purified proteins yourself, you know what a failed prep looks like and why it failed, and you are comfortable working in plates rather than one tube at a time.

You keep records someone else could follow without asking you. You say early when something is not working, and you are happy with a plan that changes as we learn.

We do not hire people into boxes. The team is small, and early hires end up owning work beyond the job they joined for. Nobody arrives with every part of this role. If you are strong in most of it and quick to learn the rest, we want to hear from you.

MUST HAVE

◆ A PhD in biochemistry, protein science, molecular biology or a related field (recent graduates welcome), or a BSc or MSc with two to three years of hands-on lab experience. Industry experience in a high-throughput setting is preferred.

◆ Molecular biology for expression: PCR, cloning by Golden Gate or Gibson assembly, and checking constructs by gel, fragment analysis or sequencing.

◆ Recombinant protein expression and purification you have run yourself, in at least one of cell-free, E. coli or mammalian systems, with affinity capture such as His, Strep or Protein A.

◆ Protein QC: quantification, SDS-PAGE or CE-SDS, and reading the results critically.

◆ Working in 96-well or 384-well plate formats, with careful, traceable record-keeping.

◆ Mammalian cell culture with good aseptic technique: adherent and suspension lines,

thawing, passaging and banking, and transient transfection of HEK293 or CHO cells for expression.

NICE TO HAVE

◆ Protein characterisation: binding kinetics by SPR or BLI, or biophysical assays such as nanoDSF, DLS or analytical SEC.

◆ Cell-based assays such as reporter bioassays for binding or blockade, receptor internalisation or cytotoxicity, with imaging or flow cytometry readouts.

◆ Liquid handlers, magnetic-bead purification systems or other lab automation.

◆ Experience with antibodies, nanobodies or other binder formats.

Why this is unusual

Most protein production roles make a handful of proteins well for one project. This one makes many, in plates, for a lab built around the quality of its data, and that changes the job in two ways.

The record is part of the product. Every construct, lot, condition and QC result is captured as structured data, including the proteins that did not express, because a result is only as trustworthy as the material behind it. And the protocols you write become the starting point for automated workflows, so they have to be precise enough for a liquid handler to follow.

That means more documentation and more standardisation than most research labs ask for.

Some people find that energising; some find it outside their lane. Worth knowing in advance which one you are.

This is a lab-based role at our site in King's Cross, London. The proteins are made in the lab, so most of your week will be too, with room for writing and analysis away from the bench.

The wider team is distributed and travels, so you will work with people who are not always in the building.

We work in the open. Decisions are written down, work happens in Slack rather than scattered across tools, and the week opens with a session the whole company attends. There is a quarterly offsite. Each person owns their area and makes the call inside it, and we will expect that of you early rather than late.

UK benefits are 30 days of annual leave plus public holidays, a pension with a 10% employer contribution, and top-tier Bupa private health cover. More is added as the team grows.

Day to day you will work with the scientists running DNA supply, molecular characterisation and the cell-based assays downstream of you, with the functional genomics team who share the cell culture suite, and with the engineers building the software and automation the lab runs on.

We are a small, elite team, and the people in it make the calls in their own areas.

Drive partner influenced pipeline, partner-sourced leads and partner influenced closed won ARR targets Keep every partnership healthy: With FDE and GTM, keep partnership health green or trending green. Surface issues early, pull in the right people to fix them, and escalate when a partnership isn't delivering value in both directions. We're a <40 person team based in-person across New York and London and are lucky to be perfectly positioned with leading customers and top investors to make a real impact on one of the largest industries in the world. Build a new kind of certification company

AI is changing how companies work. They still need independent assurance that their systems can be trusted.

Calibre is building a global certification business for that world, combining rigorous assessment with AI-powered operations.

Founded by two former Palantir engineers and backed by a $3.3m pre-seed round, we are starting with information security and expanding into AI management systems and further ISO standards. You will work directly with the founders to build the policies, processes and evidence that make that expansion possible.

What you will own

You will be the hands-on execution owner for new accreditation programmes, with an initial focus on ISO 42001 and expansion into other ISO standards. Gautham, CEO will manage you, and you will report directly to the founders.

- Write the substance. Translate standards and accreditation requirements into clear policies, procedures, responsibilities and records that reflect how Calibre actually operates.

- Find gaps and close them. Run and coordinate internal audits of Calibre's own systems, with appropriate independence and technical support. Identify missing evidence, test whether processes work, and build or improve them when they do not.

- Carry the accreditation process through. Maintain the requirements map and evidence trail; coordinate specialists, accreditation bodies and assessments; track findings, corrective actions and deadlines through to closure.

- Make the work compound. Turn each programme into reusable templates, clause mappings, evidence libraries, AI workflows and quality checks. Improve these with every assessment, then apply them to the next standard.

Support will be provided by our founders, technical specialists and commercial team, with commercial handoffs where needed. You will own making the work happen and ensuring it stands up to scrutiny.

What success looks like

A working set of internal processes that gives us confidence the next standard will be faster to add than the last: clearer requirements, stronger evidence, less repeated work and fewer avoidable gaps, while preserving the rigour of each assessment.

- 2-5 years of experience in consulting, clinical trials or medical device certification processes. You have learned to navigate complex requirements, demanding reviews and work where details matter.

About Calibre

AI systems are moving from proof of concepts into the infrastructure of everyday life. That creates a fundamental technical problem: how do you know an increasingly autonomous AI system is secure, reliable and behaving as intended? And who do you trust to answer that question?

The institutions and processes we rely on to provide that confidence were built for a slower, more predictable world. AI is advancing faster than the mechanisms we use to trust it.

Calibre is building trust for the AI era as the first AI-native certification body. We develop core technologies to understand AI and cybersecurity risk, and use them to independently assess companies against leading standards.

Founded by two ex-Palantir technical co-founders, and a founding team spanning audit and AI research, we are pushing the frontier of what trust looks like for the AI economy. We’ve raised $3.3M from top tier SF based VCs.

 

The Role

We are hiring a genuinely exceptional Product Engineer to join the founding team and build a new class of products to supercharge our AI-native certification process.

 

This person is language-agnostic, obsesses over first principles, and has already integrated LLMs into their daily workflow as a true force multiplier.

 

What You Will Do

  • Own products across the whole stack. Build and ship high-quality, high-velocity code across the full stack (front-end, back-end, and AI-agent infrastructure)

  • Build products end-to-end. Design systems from discovery through to production.

  • Engineer reliable agent systems. Design harnesses, evals and safeguards that make quality non-compromisable.

 

What we’re looking for

  • Demonstrable AI engineering depth. You can show real systems where you made substantive decisions about agent harnesses, evals, hallucination containment, performance, agent sandboxing or MCP/tool design.

  • Product instinct and clear collaboration. You ask good questions, form a view, test quickly, communicate clearly and care whether the work changes outcomes.

  • Exceptional technical talent with more than 1 year of professional experience. Your GitHub, personal projects, or hackathon wins speak for themselves.

raw.title: Fuel Oil Commodity Owner
raw.description:
We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

Fuel Oil Commodity Owner

This role can be based in either London or Singapore.

Fuel oil constantly surprises traders with its outsized moves. The question is whether you see it before everyone else does. Sparta is building the data platform that fuel oil and feedstocks traders, analysts and commercial teams use to make faster, better decisions. We cover forward curves, price assessments, market intelligence and trade flows across the global energy complex, and Fuel Oil is one of our most technical verticals. We're looking for someone to own it.

This role is an opportunity to own a vertical, build your profile, and be genuinely central to the direction of the business. We want someone who knows heavy product markets deeply and who is not afraid to build new things. Our Fuel Oil vertical already runs on market-leading tools and you will take them even further.

The role

This isn't an analyst position or a support role. It's the chance to become Sparta's primary Fuel Oil voice, internally and externally, and to shape what we build for the vertical.

You'll sit at the intersection of commercial, product, and market expertise. You'll be the internal and external authority on Fuel Oil: responsible for the health, growth, and strategic development of the vertical, while acting as a key face to clients on complex and technical engagements.

You'll need to be equally comfortable deep in the market microstructure of Fuel Oil — cash differentials, arbitrage dynamics, blend economics, price relationships across bunkering, power generation and feedstocks — as you are presenting to senior client stakeholders, shaping the product roadmap, being the market authority on the most opaque part of the oil barrel, and harnessing the power of AI to turn your knowledge into the next generation of advanced tools for fuel oil trading.

The role reports to our Head of Commodities.

What you'll do

Fuel Oil vertical ownership and strategy (~35% of role)

  • Own the Fuel Oil vertical end to end: its commercial performance, data integrity and strategic direction

  • Serve as the internal advocate for fuel oil and feedstocks across product, sales, engineering and research teams

  • Define and prioritise the Fuel Oil product roadmap with the product and technology teams

  • Act as the primary subject matter expert for all Fuel Oil decisions across the business

Building tools, models and AI agents (~25% of role)

  • Design and build Sparta’s next generation of heavy products analytical tools and pricing models

  • Own the fuel oil knowledge base behind our AI products: write the domain rules, test answers against desk judgement and catch errors before clients do

  • Prototype quickly with AI coding tools, then work with engineering to ship the ideas that work

Client interactions and technical demos (~15% of role)

  • Lead complex, discovery-focused and technical client conversations and demos

  • Support sales and account management on senior or strategically important Fuel Oil and Feedstocks opportunities

  • Represent Sparta at industry events, conferences and client visits as a Fuel Oil and Feedstocks expert

Market commentary and content (~15% of role)

  • Take editorial ownership of Fuel Oil market commentary and content

  • Define the voice and analytical framework for Fuel Oil commentary across client-facing and marketing channels

  • Work with analysts and contributors to keep output accurate, well argued and commercially relevant

Process and data quality (~10% of role)

  • Oversee the operational processes behind the vertical: cash differential modelling and uploads, component premiums and landed diffs, new arbitrage routes and price points, blend hub coverage, and ongoing data quality

  • Build scalable processes and delegate or automate routine tasks where it makes sense

What we're looking for

Required

  • Deep Fuel Oil & Feedstocks market expertise — strong working knowledge of fuel oil benchmarks, differentials, blending economics, arbitrage mechanics, refinery economics, and global heavy products flows.

  • Proven experience in a commodity-facing role within energy trading, data/analytics, financial services, or a closely related field

  • Hands-on building experience: working knowledge of Python and SQL (or equivalent) and a track record of tools or models other people actually use

  • Practical experience with AI tools such as LLMs, coding assistants or agents, and good judgement about where they get the market wrong

  • Ability to turn market complexity into clear product requirements, specifications engineers can build from, and client value propositions

  • Confident and credible in client-facing settings, including technical discovery calls and senior stakeholder presentations

  • Strong written and verbal communication, with experience producing or overseeing market commentary

  • Comfortable working across sales, product, technology and research teams

Desirable

  • Experience with pricing, data, or analytics platforms in the energy space

  • Familiarity with fuel oil data operations: cash differentials, landed diffs and price curve maintenance

  • Experience shipping work to production alongside an engineering team (version control, code review)

  • Existing network within the Fuel Oil & Feedstocks trading community

What success looks like

In your first six months, you will have:

  • Taken full ownership of the Fuel Oil vertical and its operational processes

  • Established yourself as the go-to internal and external authority on Fuel Oil and Feedstocks

  • Shipped at least one new tool, model or AI capability that clients or internal teams use

  • Measurably improved the quality of our AI products' fuel oil answers, checked against desk review

  • Built strong working relationships with the content team and begun shaping commentary output

  • Led technical client engagements independently

Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

• Experience selling financial data platforms, analytics software, or SaaS solutions directly to traders, analysts, quants or risk managers.

• Experience selling for a scale-up or challenger brand, where the name doesn’t open the door for you.

• Familiarity with HubSpot and Claude.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

We Are Sparta

Sparta is the AI leader for commodity trading, home to Leonidas AI, the first operating system for oil and commodity traders.

Backed by $42 million in Series B funding led by One Peak, with participation from returning investors FirstMark and Singular, the same investors behind AI leaders like Legora, Dataiku, and Synthesia. Most companies are building a chatbot on top of data. We've built an agent with an actual reasoning layer, grounded in years of proprietary market data and in-house trading expertise nobody else has.

We're scaling fast, and it's an exciting time to join. From independents to multinationals, the world's leading commodity teams use Sparta and Leonidas AI to move faster, trade smarter, and stay ahead of the market.

At Sparta, you'll be trusted to take ownership, backed by a team who wants you to succeed. AI is how we build here, not just what we sell. Good ideas move fast, and yours could go from staging to production in a couple of hours, whatever department you're in. You'll be challenged, supported, and given room to grow, building the AI that's changing how commodity trading gets done.

Your work has reach. From shaping Leonidas AI, to powering smarter decisions for traders around the world, to changing how commodity trading is done. And because we're growing fast, you'll accelerate your career with a level of ownership and impact you simply won't get at bigger, slower-moving companies.

The role

We’re looking for a London-based Account Manager to own and grow a portfolio of Sparta’s smaller accounts. This is a retention-and-growth role, not a new-logo hunting role: you’ll be the day-to-day commercial owner for a book of existing customers, protecting revenue at renewal and identifying and closing upsell and cross-sell opportunities within it. This is a role for someone a couple of years into account management who wants to progress quickly.

You’ll learn directly from highly experienced Account Directors and take on bigger, more complex accounts as Sparta scales. We’re growing fast, and the room to move up comes with it.

What You’ll Do

• Own a portfolio of smaller accounts, acting as the primary commercial point of contact for each customer.

• Build and execute a renewal plan for every account in your portfolio, working to protect and grow existing ARR.

• Identify and close upsell and cross-sell opportunities (additional seats, products or commodity verticals) within your existing account base.

• Consistently meet retention and expansion targets across your assigned portfolio.

• Run regular check-ins and business reviews with customers to track usage, surface risk early, and reinforce the value Sparta delivers.

• Keep account and opportunity records accurate and up to date in HubSpot, including renewals pipeline and MEDDPICC qualification.

• Partner with Customer Success on onboarding, adoption and usage data to spot expansion and churn-risk signals before they become problems.

• Escalate at-risk accounts promptly and work with the Head of Sales on recovery or win-back plans.

• Support Account Directors on strategic enterprise accounts as needed, building the experience to take on larger accounts and more senior sales responsibility over time

Who You Are

• 3+ years’ experience in an account management role, ideally in B2B SaaS, financial data or commodities.

• Hands-on ownership of both retention and expansion. You’ve run renewals and closed the upsell and cross-sell yourself, rather than passing growth opportunities to a separate salesperson to close.

• Comfortable managing a high volume of smaller accounts at once and prioritising your time effectively.

• A confident relationship-builder with strong written and verbal communication skills.

• Organised and process-driven, with a working knowledge of CRM and AI tools.

• Genuinely curious about commodities and energy markets, with a real appetite to learn.

• Resilient and proactive, comfortable working autonomously in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Nice to haves

• Prior exposure to commodities, energy markets, or financial/data services.

• Experience with MEDDPICC or another value-selling framework.

• Familiarity with HubSpot and Claude.

• An additional European language.


Why Join Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture is built on innovation, collaboration, and high performance. We thrive in a fast-paced environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are embraced, and impact is rewarded.

• Equity in a high-growth, VC-backed company

• $42M in Series B funding — strong market traction and investment

• Early-stage growth — build your career as we scale

• Market-leading product — we are redefining commodity trading intelligence

• Top-tier tools and technology to support your success

What's the Culture Like at Sparta?

At Sparta, our culture isn't just a set of values on a wall — it's how we work. We embrace a dynamic environment where initiative is celebrated, challenges are met head-on, and innovation thrives. You'll collaborate with people who are passionate about our mission and committed to building outstanding products and outcomes for our customers.

The Sparta Code

Understanding is non-negotiable

Understanding leads to believing. Believing leads to winning.

The 'why' is the difference between compliance and conviction. Before we execute, we ask: why does this matter, who does it serve, what changes if we win? People who understand the mission don't need to be managed.

Ask for forgiveness, not for permission

Most decisions are reversible. Most fears are not.

90% of decisions are reversible. Make them, ship, iterate. Perfection is the enemy of efficiency. Bias for action means moving before you have all the answers, but it isn't recklessness. The rule: tell the rest of us what you did, what changed, what you learned.

Fall in love with the problem

The mission wins. Your idea doesn't have to.

Solutions flatter our ego. They feel like progress. But solutions without problems are opinions, and opinions don't move customers, markets, or teammates. The goal is to find what's true, not to win the room. If your idea gets killed because a better one comes along, that's the system working.

It's your fault. Lucky you.

If it's on you, it's in your control.

True ownership sounds harsh until you feel how liberating it is. If every problem is yours, you stop spending energy on who to blame and start spending it on how to fix it. Effective leaders default to 'it's on me'. Not out of guilt, but out of agency.

Conflict is a gift

Honesty is an expression of care.

Withholding feedback is choosing comfort over growth, yours and your colleague's. Staying silent deprives others of the chance to learn. We challenge openly and with positive intent. Done with care, this builds trust. Done with ego, it destroys it.

Sparta Commodities is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and promotes diversity within its workforce. We are determined that no-one will ever receive less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, race, veteran status or any basis covered by appropriate law.

title: Apporteur d’affaires indépendant
description: 🚀 Apporteur d’affaires indépendant — Développez votre réseau avec PropertyOS 100 % à distance · Organisation libre · Commission sur les ventes issues de vos recommandations Vous aimez créer des contacts, repérer des opportunités et mettre les bonnes personnes en relation ? Avec PropertyOS, vous identifiez des propriétaires, bailleurs ou petites agences intéressés par une gestion immobilière plus simple. Vous organisez le rendez-vous : le fondateur assure la démonstration et le closing. 🏡 PropertyOS, c’est quoi ? PropertyOS est une plateforme SaaS qui centralise les biens immobiliers, les locataires, les finances, les documents et les tâches dans un même espace. Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de gagner du temps et de garder une vision claire de leur activité immobilière. La plateforme est accessible directement en ligne. Nous développons également un réseau de partenaires indépendants pour la faire découvrir à de nouveaux clients grâce à une approche plus personnelle. 🎯 Votre mission : créer des opportunités qualifiées Votre rôle consiste à : Identifier des propriétaires bailleurs, investisseurs et petites agences susceptibles d’être intéressés. Entrer en contact avec eux et comprendre leur organisation actuelle. Présenter simplement PropertyOS et son intérêt. Vérifier leur intérêt pour une démonstration et pour le budget proposé. Organiser un rendez-vous avec le fondateur. Enregistrer les informations utiles dans PropertyOS Advisor pour préparer l’échange. Vous vous concentrez sur la prospection et la mise en relation. Le fondateur prend ensuite le relais pour la démonstration détaillée, les questions commerciales, la négociation et la conclusion de l’abonnement. Vous ne négociez pas les conditions et ne signez pas de contrat au nom de PropertyOS. ⚡ PropertyOS Advisor : votre application partenaire Vous disposez de PropertyOS Advisor , notre application dédiée aux apporteurs d’affaires. Pensée pour fluidifier votre activité, elle vous permet de centraliser les informations de vos prospects, suivre vos mises en relation et transmettre le contexte nécessaire à la préparation des rendez-vous. L’objectif : une prospection organisée et un passage de relais simple , pour donner à chaque opportunité les meilleures chances d’aboutir. 💸 Une rémunération liée aux clients apportés L’offre mise en avant dans ce partenariat est l’abonnement annuel PropertyOS à 990 € . Vous percevez une commission pour chaque nouveau client qui souscrit et règle cet abonnement à la suite de votre mise en relation, selon les conditions prévues au contrat. Rémunération à la commission uniquement. Aucun salaire fixe ni revenu garanti. Le montant de la commission et le calendrier de versement sont communiqués avant tout engagement. Les règles d’attribution des prospects, de traitement des doublons et d’annulation sont précisées au contrat. Un rendez-vous seul ne déclenche pas de commission : celle-ci dépend de la souscription et de l’encaissement correspondants. 👋 À qui s’adresse cette opportunité ? 🏡 PropertyOS, c’est quoi ?

PropertyOS est une plateforme SaaS qui centralise les biens immobiliers, les locataires, les finances, les documents et les tâches dans un même espace.

Notre ambition : permettre aux propriétaires et gestionnaires de gagner du temps et de garder une vision claire de leur activité immobilière.

Votre rôle consiste à :

  • Identifier des propriétaires bailleurs, investisseurs et petites agences susceptibles d’être intéressés.

  • Entrer en contact avec eux et comprendre leur organisation actuelle.

  • Présenter simplement PropertyOS et son intérêt.

  • We win 86% of live RFPs against our biggest competitor

  • More than 3x ARR growth in the last 12 months, with 40% in Q3 alone

  • Under 20% of enterprises use modern procurement software today. Gartner expects that to reach 50% by 2027

  • Own the France number: set the territory plan, choose the target accounts and build pipeline from day one

  • Lead from the front as Omnea's face in France: customer meetings, CFO dinners, industry events and partner conversations

  • Build the team as the market earns it: hire and coach the AEs who follow you, and set the standard they sell to

  • Take what you hear from buyers straight to product and marketing, so we win more in France

  • 8+ years in B2B SaaS, with a strong record of closing complex enterprise new business yourself

  • Experience leading or building a sales team, ideally in a new market or a fast-growing business

  • Fluent French and English

  • A player-coach who would rather be in the deal than in a dashboard

  • Credible with C-suite buyers, especially Finance, Procurement and Legal

  • Comfortable building from zero: no local team and no playbook handed to you, just a proven product and a market to win

  • Bonus: you've opened a new market or been an early leader at a scale-up

This role is remote while we build our presence in France.

  • We're commercial, ambitious and we don't pretend otherwise! We're actively seeking folks looking to make the most of a career-defining opportunity, with the hunger to be part of building something really impressive. You can see our values here and our Omnea Future Founder's fund here!

  • We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background).

We are proud to be recognised for both our culture and product, and we are just getting started. Join us as we grow!

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif. L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain. À Mines Saint-Étienne, nos centres de recherche sont le cœur battant de notre École. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques. Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret. Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité. Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire  mieux, avec moins. L’objectif ?  Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité. 🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’ industrie du futur.  Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ? 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous En tant que doctorant, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions de recherche et innovation et, dans une moindre mesure de nos missions d’enseignement. Vous serez affecté au centre SPIN – LGF (Laboratoire Georges Friedel, UMR CNRS 5307). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal. Le centre SPIN (Science des Procédés Industriels et Naturels), qui sera fortement impliqué dans la thèse, développe, au sein de Mines Saint-Etienne, son expertise dans le domaine du Génie des Procédés appliqué aux systèmes dispersés : grains, particules, gouttes, bulles, milieux poreux. Il possède également des compétences en développement de capteurs et d’instrumentation. Les technologies de captage et stockage du CO2 sont des technologies clés pour la décarbonation du secteur industriel. Les stockages offshores ont déjà démontré leur faisabilité, mais les stockages onshores semblent nécessaires pour augmenter les capacités de stockage tout en réduisant le transport de CO2. Or, la proximité de ces sites avec les populations rend leurs déploiements incertains et soulève des questions relatives à l’acceptabilité sociale. La surveillance à long terme des sites de stockage de CO2, exigée par la directive européenne CCS, constitue une opportunité pour renforcer la transparence et l’acceptation locale du stockage en engageant les parties prenantes dans l’acquisition et l’interprétation des données. Cependant, les systèmes actuels de surveillance ne permettent pas à la fois de réaliser des mesures in-situ, simulations numériques et visualisation interactive pour une approche du suivi intégrée des sites de stockage. Le projet CO2MET vise à développer et faire progresser des unités ou éléments clés pour préparer un futur système intégré de surveillance numérique à long terme améliorant la fiabilité et l’acceptabilité du stockage géologique de CO2. Pour atteindre ces objectifs, le consortium CO2MET a été constitué et est composé de l'IFPEN, du BRGM, de Mines Saint-Etienne et de Cerema. Étant donné que les signaux de concentration en CO₂ peuvent, à eux seuls, ne pas être suffisamment discriminants (les concentrations biologiques dans les sols pouvant dépasser 10 % vol.), compte tenu de leurs origines diverses (sources profondes, provenant du stockage ou de l’interaction gaz-roche ; processus de respiration ; oxydation du méthane), la prévention des faux positifs dans la surveillance des sites de stockage doit s'appuyer sur des capteurs de CO₂ (NDIR ou photoacoustiques) et sur d'autres capteurs (par exemple, un capteur chimique d'O₂), ainsi que sur des capteurs environnementaux (humidité, pression, température) afin de permettre une attribution correcte de la source de CO2. Parmi les missions qui lui seront attribuées, le doctorant devra : · Sélectionner des capteurs existants répondants aux spécifications afin de mettre au point une plateforme de détection  · Etudier, en conditions de laboratoire, la sélectivité des capteurs vis-à-vis des espèces gazeuses interférentes, à l’aide d’une analyse multivariée · Définir des algorithmes de prédiction tenant compte de la reproductibilité, de la dérive, de la linéarité et de la variabilité dans des mélanges gazeux complexes et des conditions environnementales variables (température, pression et humidité relative) · Etudier l'influence du vieillissement des capteurs sur leur réponse et sur les prévisions établies, afin de proposer un algorithme de compensation ·  Enfin, mener des études de cas concrets sur le site de Sainte-Marguerite (Puy-de-Dôme), avec des niveaux d'émissions de CO₂ variables, afin de tester et de valider les plateformes de capteurs développées. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux. Grâce à des outils d’élaboration et de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nous déployons le concept de «Material by design» : concevoir au mieux les matériaux de demain répondant aux enjeux de transition. Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.   Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet VARIMA (VAlorisation des Résidus d’Incinération en Matériaux Avancés) du dispositif Partenariats d'innovation Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - volet Preuves de Concept. L’incinération des déchets ménagers produit, en plus de l'énergie, des résidus contenant des métaux et des minéraux. Des entreprises récupèrent et recyclent les différents métaux. Cependant, des milliers de tonnes de poussières minérales sont générées et sont généralement envoyées en décharge faute de solution de valorisation. Ce  post-doctorat, d’une durée de 18 mois  vise à étudier la valorisation des poussières d’incinération par deux voies d’élaboration : voie géopolymères et voie métallurgie des poudres. Les matériaux obtenus seront ensuite caractérisés au niveau microstructural mais aussi au niveau des propriétés d’usage (propriétés mécanique et thermique ainsi que la tenue à la lixiviation). Ø  Développement et optimisation des matrices liantes. Pilotage des formulations expérimentales en laboratoire pour les deux voies de valorisation afin de lever les verrous scientifiques majeurs (gestion du soufre et des inhibiteurs de prise comme le ZnO). Conception et optimisation des formulations de géopolymères. Optimisation des programmes de frittage des céramiques denses. Ø  Évaluation de la durabilité, de la conformité réglementaire et lixiviation. Assurer la qualification technique et environnementale des matériaux développés pour garantir leur transférabilité vers le marché de la construction. Réaliser les tests de performance mécanique et de durabilité (stabilité face à l'expansion sulfatique). Ø  Gestion de projet, animation du partenariat et valorisation scientifique. Assurer le suivi opérationnel quotidien du projet VARIMA et la diffusion des connaissances au sein de l'écosystème concerné. Participation à l’encadrement des stagiaires associés aux travaux et maintien d’un lien technique étroit avec le partenaire industriel pour le partage des résultats. raw.title: Post-doctorant.e : "Elaboration et caractérisation de matériaux inorganiques à partir d’une mine urbaine" - CDD 18 mois
raw.description:
Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est s’engager dans une institution où la science et l’innovation bâtissent un avenir plus durable. Une école d’excellence où chacun a l’opportunité de révéler son plein potentiel et de contribuer à relever les défis de demain.

Classée parmi les meilleures écoles d’ingénieurs en France et reconnue mondialement, notre école, membre de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, forme les talents de demain tout en contribuant activement à relever les grands défis industriels, numériques et environnementaux. Avec nous, vous intégrez une communauté de 500 collaborateurs, 2500 étudiants, et participez à un projet ambitieux : conjuguer excellence académique, recherche d’avant-garde et impact sociétal positif.

L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Avec ses 8 Grandes Écoles publiques et 2 écoles filiales, il est le premier institut public dédié aux ingénieurs et managers. Ensemble, nous imaginons et construisons un avenir durable, en formant les acteurs qui façonneront les transitions de demain.

Bienvenue dans l’univers des matériaux du futur !

Au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS), on décortique la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nos enseignants-chercheurs inventent le concept de « Material by design » : concevoir les matériaux dès l’atelier de recherche, pour une performance sur-mesure.

🧠 Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que post-doctorant.e, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affectées au centre Science des Matériaux et des Structures (SMS), rattaché au Laboratoire Georges Friedel (unité mixte de recherche CNRS). Au sein de ce centre, vous conjuguez passion scientifique et impact sociétal, « en décortiquant » la matière pour mieux la maîtriser. Alliages métalliques, céramiques, composites… ici, on explore le lien entre procédés, microstructures et propriétés des matériaux.

Grâce à des outils d’élaboration et de caractérisation avancée et des modèles multi-échelles, nous déployons le concept de «Material by design» : concevoir au mieux les matériaux de demain répondant aux enjeux de transition.

Vous aimez la science fondamentale qui change le réel ? C’est ici que ça se passe.

 

Ce post-doctorat s’inscrit dans le cadre du projet VARIMA (VAlorisation des Résidus d’Incinération en Matériaux Avancés) du dispositif Partenariats d'innovation Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes - volet Preuves de Concept. L’incinération des déchets ménagers produit, en plus de l'énergie, des résidus contenant des métaux et des minéraux. Des entreprises récupèrent et recyclent les différents métaux. Cependant, des milliers de tonnes de poussières minérales sont générées et sont généralement envoyées en décharge faute de solution de valorisation.

Ce post-doctorat, d’une durée de 18 mois vise à étudier la valorisation des poussières d’incinération par deux voies d’élaboration : voie géopolymères et voie métallurgie des poudres. Les matériaux obtenus seront ensuite caractérisés au niveau microstructural mais aussi au niveau des propriétés d’usage (propriétés mécanique et thermique ainsi que la tenue à la lixiviation). Le post-doctorant.e contribuera durant la deuxième année de ce CDD à une étude d’impact relative au procédés développés.

· Vous faites preuve d'une grande autonomie dans la conduite de vos travaux expérimentaux tout en montrant une rigueur scientifique exemplaire

· Vous rendez compte des résultats à vos encadrants et à l’entreprise partenaire du projet

· Vous participez aux réunions de suivi de projet et à la rédaction des livrables

Votre capacité à travailler en mode projet et à faire dialoguer recherche et application concrète sera essentielle pour réussir.

🚀 Missions

Ø  Caractérisation physico-chimique et bifurcation des flux de poussières.

  • Mise en œuvre des outils de la plateforme (DRX, FRX, ICP-MS, ATG/DSC, granulométrie laser, etc.

  • Validation et application du protocole de bifurcation technique pour orienter chaque lot vers la voie optimale.

Ø  Développement et optimisation des matrices liantes.

Pilotage des formulations expérimentales en laboratoire pour les deux voies de valorisation afin de lever les verrous scientifiques majeurs (gestion du soufre et des inhibiteurs de prise comme le ZnO).

  • Conception et optimisation des formulations de géopolymères.

  • Optimisation des programmes de frittage des céramiques denses.

Ø  Évaluation de la durabilité, de la conformité réglementaire et lixiviation.

Assurer la qualification technique et environnementale des matériaux développés pour garantir leur transférabilité vers le marché de la construction.

  • Réaliser les tests de performance mécanique et de durabilité (stabilité face à l'expansion sulfatique).

  • Conduire les tests de lixiviation normalisés (NF EN 12457-2) pour démontrer la conformité réglementaire vis-à-vis des seuils de stockage (ISDI) et participer à la rédaction technique de la proposition d’une fiche matière GAMAA et d’un dossier technique d’application.

Ø  Analyse de Cycle de Vie et de soutenabilité.

  • Collecte des données d'inventaire

  • Participation à la modélisation pour quantifier les bénéfices (réduction du CO2) et à l’évaluation des dimensions socio-économiques locales.

Ø  Gestion de projet, animation du partenariat et valorisation scientifique.

Assurer le suivi opérationnel quotidien du projet VARIMA et la diffusion des connaissances au sein de l'écosystème concerné.

  • Participation à l’encadrement des stagiaires associés aux travaux et maintien d’un lien technique étroit avec le partenaire industriel pour le partage des résultats.

  • Rédaction des rapports d'avancement du projet.

  • Valorisation des résultats à travers la rédaction d'articles scientifiques internationaux à comité de lecture, participation à des congrès, et contribution à la détection d'opportunités de brevets.


🔍 Ce que nous recherchons

Vous êtes titulaire d’un :

  • Doctorat (PhD) ou équivalent en Chimie des matériaux, Sciences et Génie des matériaux ou des procédés, Génie civil.

Et idéalement :

  • Avec une expérience sur l’élaboration et la caractérisation de matériaux inorganiques.

  • Une appétence pour les travaux expérimentaux.

  • Une maîtrise de l’anglais (niveau C1) et, idéalement, une expérience internationale

Vos atouts supplémentaires :

  • Capacité à travailler en équipe

  • Capacité à dialoguer avec des interlocuteurs académiques et industriels

  • Excellente capacité de rédaction en français et en anglais

Mines Saint-Étienne, école de l’Institut Mines-Télécom, assure des missions de formation, de recherche, d’innovation et de transfert industriel. Avec 2 500 élèves, 500 personnels et un budget de 50 M€, elle dispose de trois campus spécialisés. Sa stratégie 2023-2027 vise à accompagner les transitions écologique, numérique et générationnelle, tout en contribuant à la souveraineté nationale et européenne en microélectronique et numérique. Le campus Aix-Marseille-Provence, situé à Gardanne, regroupe le Centre Microélectronique de Provence (CMP), des formations d’ingénieurs et de masters, un incubateur technologique et des plateformes de prototypage. Il accueille environ 400 étudiants et 200 personnels de Mines Saint-Étienne et d’entreprises partenaires. Le CMP dispose d’une salle blanche de 700 m², équipée d’une centaine d’équipements scientifiques répartis en zones de classes 100, 1 000 et 10 000. Cette plateforme est utilisée par les équipes de recherche, les membres académiques et industriels de l’association Micro-PackS, ainsi que pour les formations initiales et continues. Ses activités couvrent notamment les procédés de couches minces, la photolithographie, la chimie, la caractérisation physique et électrique des matériaux et dispositifs, le micropackaging, l’électronique imprimée et la préparation d’échantillons. 🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous Dans le cadre du projet I-novmicro porté par le Campus des Métiers et des Qualifications Industrie du Futur, des modules de formation aux procédés de fabrication en microélectronique sont proposés à des étudiants et apprenants en formation initiale ou continue. La formation se concentrera sur la réalisation de transistor NMOS. Le Centre de Microélectronique de Provence recrute un ingénieur pour mettre en place et dispenser ces formations, gérer les opérations nécessaires au bon déroulement de celles-ci. Vos Missions : Achat d’équipements La personne retenue gérera, dans un premier temps, l’achat de nouveaux équipements destinés aux formations décrites en introduction. Elle assurera ensuite l’animation des sessions de formation aux procédés microélectroniques associées à ce module. Ainsi, la personne recrutée devra être former aux procédés standard utilisés en microélectronique (front-end), et effectuer les étapes de fabrication de composants, développées dans le cadre des formations dispensées. Elle sera également en charge du développement de nouveaux procédés. Dans le cadre de ces missions, la ou le titulaire du poste devra utiliser des produits chimiques, et donc en gérer les aspects sécurité. Elle devra utiliser des équipements de caractérisation (ex : microscopie, ellipsométrie, profilométrie) dans le cadre des formations dispensées, et devra pouvoir former des utilisateurs à ces techniques. Recherche Etant associé aux départements de recherche du CMP, notamment le département d’électronique flexible, des activités complémentaires de recherche sont envisageables. 🔍 Ce que nous recherchons Les candidates et candidats doivent être titulaires au minimum d’un bac+5, et avoir une expérience dans la microélectronique, en process et caractérisation en salle blanche. Une forte polyvalence est requise pour ce poste, avec notamment des compétences en :          Procédés (connaissance et maîtrise) : photolithographie, gravure humide et sèche, dépôts de couches minces et traitements thermiques,          Caractérisation physique de matériaux et dispositifs, et caractérisation électrique de dispositifs. Une expérience dans le domaine de la formation technique est un réel atout. Les qualités requises pour le poste sont la pédagogie, l’autonomie, la rigueur, la méthode et l’organisation dans le travail, l’habileté technique et une aisance en communication orale et écrite. solutions qui résonnent dans chaque marché, avec sa propre langue, sa culture métier et son contexte réglementaire.</p> <p><strong>Responsabilités</strong></p> <ul> <li>Recruter, manager et guider une piloter l’adoption des produits Anthropic dans des secteurs verticaux spécifiques ou des cas d’usage horizontaux</li> <li>Aider les clients à naviguer dans les exigences réglementaires locales et :</strong></p> <ul> <li>Avez 7+ ans d’expérience en gestion de pré-vente technique, incluant un leadership de deuxième niveau ou supérieur (direction de managers)</li> <li>Avez vendu des produits avec les parties prenantes en matière de risque, de conformité et de comité d’entreprise</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Role:</strong></p> <p>As the 2nd-line leader for </li> <li> <p>Stay current with emerging AI trends and the competitive landscape.</p> </li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>You may be a good fit if you:</strong></p> <ul> <li> <p>7+ years of technical
